name: 92345 · Hesperia, CA
findings: ZIP 92345 (Hesperia) has 133 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92345 (Hesperia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92345 (Hesperia) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
